events.tagZh: Sydney Opera House / 亲子剧场
events.summaryZh: Sydney Opera House 的 Utzon Room 变成冰雪和水声的感官剧场，孩子可以跟着表演穿越南极景象，适合想把歌剧院行程做得轻松又有想象力的家庭。
events.summaryEn: Sydney Opera House turns the Utzon Room into a sensory trip across ice and water, giving families a compact theatre outing with strong visuals and sound for children aged 4 and over.
events.timeZh: 8月1日周六 10:00am、12:00pm、3:00pm；8月2日周日 10:00am；8月3日周一 12:00pm；8月4日周二 3:00pm

events.titleZh: Andy Griffiths Live: You & Me and the Gigantic Knucklehead
events.titleEn: Andy Griffiths Live: You & Me and the Gigantic Knucklehead
events.summaryZh: Andy Griffiths 和插画师 Bill Hope 会用讲故事、绘画和互动把新书里的巨人世界带到舞台上，适合喜欢 Treehouse 系列、想要一小时高能文学活动的家庭。
events.summaryEn: Andy Griffiths and illustrator Bill Hope bring the new giant-themed book to life with drawing, storytelling and audience interaction, making it a lively one-hour literature outing for families.

events.summaryZh: Hay St Market 在活动最后一个周末保留溜冰、飘雪、现场娱乐和冬季小吃，白天带孩子逛更轻松，晚上则适合全家一起感受城市冬日气氛。
events.summaryEn: Hay St Market keeps ice skating, snowfall moments, entertainment and winter food running through the final weekend, giving families an easy city winter precinct before it closes.
events.timeZh: 7月31日周五至8月1日周六 8:00am-10:00pm；8月2日周日 8:00am-6:00pm
events.timeEn: Friday 31 July to Saturday 1 August, 8:00am-10:00pm; Sunday 2 August, 8:00am-6:00pm
events.priceZh: 免费入场；部分体验需另订

events.referenceEn: City of Sydney and Hay St Market official pages verified the run to 2 August, opening hours, free entry and family suitability.

events.titleZh: Come Alive! The Greatest Showman Circus Spectacular
events.titleEn: Come Alive! The Greatest Showman Circus Spectacular
events.summaryZh: Entertainment Quarter 的大帐篷把 The Greatest Showman 歌曲、空中特技和马戏表演放在一起，活动到8月2日结束，适合想要热闹夜场或周末下午场的家庭。
events.summaryEn: The Entertainment Quarter big top combines songs from The Greatest Showman with aerial acts and circus performance, with final-weekend sessions suited to families wanting a big shared show.
events.timeZh: 7月31日周五 7:30pm；8月1日周六 2:30pm、7:30pm；8月2日周日 1:00pm、6:30pm

events.summaryZh: Sydney Observatory 的小团家庭导览会讲旗号、天气观测和望远镜历史，孩子还能进入穹顶看望远镜，适合6岁以上、想把港口景色和科学故事结合的家庭。
events.summaryEn: Sydney Observatory family tours cover signalling, weather and telescope history before entering the domes, pairing harbour views with a science-focused visit for children aged 6 and over.
events.timeZh: 本周五、周六 12:30pm-8:00pm；需选择官方场次

events.referenceEn: City of Sydney and Powerhouse official pages verified the Friday and Saturday hours, ages 6+ suitability, venue and pricing.

events.summaryZh: Sydney Park Cycling Centre 的免费平衡车课让家长陪孩子练习从平衡车过渡到脚踏车，现场提供车和头盔，也可以自带装备，适合想要户外放电的3至8岁孩子。
events.summaryEn: Sydney Park Cycling Centre runs a free balance-bike clinic where parents help children move toward pedal-bike confidence, with bikes and helmets supplied or bring-your-own gear welcome.
events.timeEn: Saturday 1 August, 9:00am-11:00am; arrive by 10:45am to register
events.priceEn: Free; may be cancelled in wet weather

events.referenceEn: City of Sydney and BikeWise official listing verified the Saturday time, free entry, ages 3-8 suitability, outdoor conditions and walk-up registration.

events.summaryZh: Australian Museum 的吸血生物展用互动装置、显微镜和可触摸模型解释蚊子、水蛭等生物，适合喜欢自然科学、又能接受一点怪趣味的家庭。
events.summaryEn: Australian Museum's exhibition uses interactives, microscopes and touchable models to explain mosquitoes, leeches and other blood-feeders for science-minded families.
events.timeEn: Daily this week, 10:00am-4:00pm; exhibition runs until 11 October
events.referenceZh: City of Sydney 和 Australian Museum 官方页面核实了展期、每日开放时间、票价和家庭适合说明。

events.summaryZh: Sydney Olympic Park 的 Harry Potter 展把电影道具、服装和互动场景集中在一起，孩子可以近距离看熟悉角色和魔法世界细节，适合想安排半日室内展览的家庭。
events.summaryEn: Harry Potter: The Exhibition gathers props, costumes and interactive moments at Sydney Olympic Park, giving families a half-day indoor screen-world outing.
events.timeEn: Daily this week, 10:00am-6:00pm; exhibition runs until 11 October
